deploy.startCommand:
bash -c 'mkdir -p /data/config /data/tdai-memory || true; cat > /data/config/tdai-gateway.yaml << "YAMLEOF"
deployMode: standalone
server:
  port: 8420
  host: 0.0.0.0
data:
  baseDir: /data/tdai-memory
llm:
  baseUrl: "${TDAI_LLM_BASE_URL}"
  apiKey: "${TDAI_LLM_API_KEY}"
  model: "${TDAI_LLM_MODEL}"
  maxTokens: 32000
  timeoutMs: 300000
memory:
  promptMode: code
  capture:
    enabled: true
  extraction:
    enabled: true
    enableDedup: true
    maxMemoriesPerSession: 20
  persona:
    triggerEveryN: 50
    maxScenes: 15
  pipeline:
    everyNConversations: 5
    enableWarmup: false
  recall:
    enabled: true
    maxResults: 5
    scoreThreshold: 0.3
    strategy: bm25
    timeoutMs: 5000
  storeBackend: sqlite
  embedding:
    provider: openai
    baseUrl: "${TDAI_LLM_BASE_URL}"
    apiKey: "${TDAI_LLM_API_KEY}"
    model: text-embedding-3-small
    dimensions: 1536
  bm25:
    enabled: true
    language: zh
skill:
  enabled: true
  routing:
    mode: bm25
    searchTopK: 20
  extraction:
    enabled: true
    maxIterations: 16
    queue:
      backend: local
      keyPrefix: tdai
      resultTtlSeconds: 86400
      lockTtlMs: 600000
      maxRetries: 2
      retryBackoffsMs: [5000, 15000]
  resources:
    maxResourceSizeBytes: 5000000
observability:
  otel:
    enabled: false
  clickhouse:
    enabled: false
  kafka:
    enabled: false
  langfuse:
    enabled: false
metadata:
  maxUsersPerInstance: 500
  maxTeamsPerInstance: 100
  store:
    sqliteBaseDir: /data/tdai-memory/metadata-v2
YAMLEOF
export TDAI_GATEWAY_PORT="${PORT:-8420}"
exec node --import tsx src/gateway/server.ts'
